title: Version-mismatch paired Renode run extended to 60 virtual seconds
scope: Same inputs as the 5:55 AM CST 8s mismatch experiment (stock 2.2.6.10 vs 12 Nov diagnostic openCFW main, NOR with official firmware/ble_em9305.bin, controller word forced to 4.3.1.0). RunFor extended to 60 virtual seconds with PC peeks at 0/8/30/60s. No source or emulator change. No hardware flash.

opencfw_app.note: Same diagnostic image as the 8s mismatch, not the later advertising-disarm rebuild, so this is a direct extension of that experiment. CHIPREV stayed at the model default 0, so the early-arm hook would have been a no-op even on the newer image.

stock-mismatch-60s.pc_after_60s_site: Inside stock am_hal_delay_us at 0x4807a0 (movs r1, #15 at 0x4807be, then bl 0x40 to the ITCM delay overlay). Same delay family as the 8s/30s ITCM PC 0x42.

opencfw-mismatch-60s.pc_after_60s_site: br_util_delay_cycles at 0x006006f4 (.itcm_text). The 8s mismatch ended at 0x6006f6, one instruction inside the same helper.

emulator_limits: The EM9305 model still does not implement controller NVM program/erase, so the recover/reconfigure/finalize path never issues those HCI commands in this run.

On watchdog reset the model logs 'No action for reset - macro g2.reset is not registered' and only reloads the scripted CPU PC/SP (stock 0x5E4233, openCFW 0x594005). That is not a full SoC or SBL reset. After each such restart both images repeat the same two 0xFD01 reads.
